names_join: Normalize common names by stripping nonalphanumeric ASCII, exact one-to-one; no manual matching based on geographic results
reprojection: Read original .prj per species, transform all Shapefile break lines and polygons to WGS84 EPSG:4326; construct per-species local azimuthal equidistant (AEQD) projection anchored to sampled polygon representative point for distance calculations
fix_invalid_polygon: Apply shapely.make_valid if invalid; count repaired species; never change break-line topology or shift geometry
spatial_support_definition: positive mapped Pleistocene break-line length >0, range polygon area >0, and at least one portion of the break-line within 50km of source supplied clipped polygon; 50km is from original 2024 source position-jitter sensitivity, not chosen after seeing spatial overlaps
blocking: If <50 support-qualified species, NOT_EVALUABLE before historical climate predictors or break/background labels evaluated
interpretation: Overlap is only QC for genuine spatial comparability; not evidence that historical climate predicts break locations.
